_doc: Image generator settings for tools/artgen.py. 'provider' is the USER's choice (codex | grok | novelai | a custom name); null = ask them (python tools/artgen.py providers). A job's own "provider" field wins over this. Never put keys or passwords in this file: NovelAI reads NOVELAI_API_KEY from the environment.
